description:
SPECIFICATION 
T247 London Plane
2.5-3m crown reduction in spread for northern crown only at a height of 2m - 10m above ground level (ie lower-mid crown only), leaving a canopy spread of 9 metres for this northern crown

T248 London Plane
2.0-2.5m crown reduction in spread for northern crown only at a height of 2m - 10m above ground level (ie lower-mid crown only), leaving a canopy spread of 8 metres for this northern crown

JUSTIFICATION
To facilitate development work in relation to Application Reference 22/3004/FUL  (Approved): To provide clearance from building (Sports changing block) including any scaffold erection
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
site_name: Kneller Hall Royal Military School Of Music
